title: Sanctity of Life
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: If a child speaks of harming himself or others, follow the safeguarding policy at once.

skills.key_step: The child identifies practices that violate the right to life (murder, mob justice, abortion, drugs, reckless driving), outlines their effects, explains the teaching (Exodus 20:13; Matthew 5:21-22: anger matters too) and lists virtues that protect life (love, self-control, forgiveness, respect).

floor.prerequisite: Knows God is the source of life.
floor.question: Who is the source of life?

contexts: a crowd beating a suspected thief
a fight at a football match

board.say: What does Jesus add to "do not murder"?

board.do: Wait for the child to say anger and insults matter too.

misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 2:7: God breathed life into the man. Life is a gift we care for.

misconceptions.ask: A crowd catches a thief and wants to beat him. What is right?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: who has the right to judge? The police and courts. Every life, even a thief's, is sacred.

misconceptions.ask: What does Jesus teach about anger (Matthew 5:21-22)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 5:21-22: Jesus names anger and insults too. Deal with anger early.

listen_for: No, it is only my own life
misconceptions.ask: Does taking drugs or reckless dares go against the sacredness of life?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Corinthians 6:19-20: your body is not your own. Protect your own life as well as others'.

checks.question: A crowd wants to beat a thief. What is right?
Name a virtue that protects life.
